description: React component for a task management dashboard with task lists, tag management, and task actions.

methods.name: handleEditTaskList
methods.description: Sets the editing state for a specific task list.

methods.name: handleAddTaskToList
methods.description: Sets the state to add a task to a specific list.

methods.name: handleCompleteListTasks
methods.description: Completes all tasks in a specific list based on its filters.

methods.name: handleDeleteListCompletedTasks
methods.description: Deletes all completed tasks in a specific list based on its filters.

methods.name: handleSaveListConfig
methods.description: Saves the updated configuration for a task list and closes the editor.
